rounds.title: Single theme source
rounds.interviewerPrompt: Make the visible theme, label, and document state derive from one value.
constraints: Start in the resolved light theme when no preference exists.
Toggle atomically between light and dark.
Apply the current theme to the application root and keep the visible label synchronized.

frameworkTests.name: Round 1 · Toggle has one observable state

rounds.title: Preference resolution
rounds.interviewerPrompt: Treat persistence as an explicit user preference rather than an incidental render effect.
constraints: Read a valid saved preference once during initialization.
Persist only explicit light or dark values and ignore malformed storage data.
Use the system color-scheme preference only when no explicit preference exists.
Keep browser storage access safe when rendering outside the browser.

rounds.title: Accessible toggle contract
rounds.interviewerPrompt: Expose the current preference without making users infer it from color.
constraints: Use a native button with an unambiguous accessible name.
Announce the current theme in a polite status element.
Rapid input must not desynchronize label, pressed state, and root theme.

frameworkTests.name: Round 3 · Pressed state and announcement match
